These parameters are for the 2-ohm motor. Also, they are the net values for BOTH pistons (cones). In other words, the two pistons are treated as a single driver.

The ContraBase driver is not a traditional moving coil driver. Rather, it is a rotary motor that is mechanically connected to two opposing cone pistons. From the outside, the driver looks like two conventional 15-inch woofers that are mounted on opposite sides of a cabinet.
